title: Order Rail, refined
question: Order Rail after layout, clarify, onboard and distill. Lock it, steer it again, or re-roll.

options.label: Order Rail, refined
options.lineage: kitchen order tickets on the pass rail
options.thesis: Queued messages clip to a rail above the composer; the send button always names what Enter does.
options.viewport: Rail of queued tickets, then the composer: a caption head (model · effort · mode, context %), the body, and a foot with Attach, Commands, Stop, Steer now and Queue.
options.risk: Two send buttons while a turn runs; if Steer is misread as the default, messages interrupt the agent.

raised.raise: Head drops agent name and branch (the breadcrumb has them); HOLD/FIRE toggle and hint line become one primary button.
Queue and Steer replace HOLD and FIRE; Medium becomes Medium effort; Auto mode states it approves tools for you.
Settings (changed rarely) sit in the head, actions (every message) in the foot, so Auto mode no longer weighs the same as effort.
The placeholder teaches the current state: idle reads Message this agent · / for commands, a running turn reads Queue a message for after this turn.
A removed queued ticket stays in place as Removed · Undo for a few seconds.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The Claude Desktop / Cursor composer, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Rounded field, settings as quiet inline selects, attach and send at the corners, a context ring by Send.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other agent chat app by design.
